subject: On-prem keystore — capex vs usage reconciliation
messages:
From: Tom Myers <tom.myers@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 09:15:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Keystore options / evidence timing

Diego —

Thanks for walking the Greenline team through the security add-ons last week. Procurement asked me to follow up with a couple of precise asks so we can compare total cost of ownership:

1) If we go with on‑prem HSM seats (customer-managed keystore) what does the capex profile look like vs an equivalent managed KMS path across year 1–3? We need an amortized view (monthly) we can drop into our finance model.

2) For on‑prem HSM, are there ongoing support/renewal lines we should budget for separately (firmware, attestations, emergency on‑call)?

3) If we pursue Redwood Managed KMS with an HSM backing, how does the usage surcharge behave at scale — are there hard caps or tier discounts?

4) Evidence delivery: procurement needs a clear timeline for SOC2/attestation artifacts and a sample evidence package for our auditors. If evidence is staged by milestone, what are the triggers you recommend?

We are trying to avoid a large up‑front payment if possible. If Redwood has amortization or crediting approaches (pilot credits, commit credits, implementation-waive options) that would make the numbers line up with our capital plan, please include those.

I attached an excerpt of our RFP and the finance template we use.

Cheers,
Tom Myers
Director, Procurement
Greenline Health
attachments: Greenline_RFP_v3.pdf, finance_template_greenline.xlsx

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Myers <tom.myers@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 11:02:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: Keystore options / evidence timing

Tom —

Appreciate the clarity. I did a quick pass with pricing/ops and attached a starter cost workbook (cost_breakdown_greenline_v1.xlsx). High level options below — happy to walk through on a 30‑minute call tomorrow.

Option A: On‑prem HSM (customer keystore)
- One‑time HSM seat fee billed up front (license + provisioning).
- Annual support & attestation bundle (firmware updates, annual attestation) = recurring charge (~10–12% of capex annually in our model).
- Implementation services (onboarding, key sync, verifying attestations) — typically a one‑time professional services line; can be amortized over 12–24 months on request.

Pros: tightest data control, predictable latency.
Cons: higher up‑front; ops burden for Greenline.

Option B: Redwood Managed KMS (HSM-backed)
- No hardware capex — monthly usage + a small per‑transaction or per‑key active fee.
- Tiered discounts at commit bands (>= $75k/mo, >= $250k/mo) lower per‑unit charge.
- Optional SLA add‑on for dedicated HSM reservation (reserved capacity surcharge).

Pros: lower upfront, simpler for your ops team; built‑in evidence gathering.
Cons: slightly higher unit cost at very low volumes; routing to dedicated HSM incurs surcharge.

Crediting / amortization ideas we can offer
- Pilot credit: up to 50% of implementation services credited against first 6 months of usage on a signed 12‑month commit.
- Implementation amortization: we can spread implementation fees as monthly credits over 12 months on a committed contract.
- Evidence delivery milestone credits: partial credits tied to delivery of SOC2 artifacts or onboarding milestones.

Evidence timing (recommended)
- Milestone 1 (Pilot launch): baseline evidence package (architecture, access controls) — within 2 weeks of pilot start.
- Milestone 2 (HSM provisioning / attestations): hardware attestation + key ownership proof — within 4–6 weeks of provisioning.
- Milestone 3 (SOC2 / audit): full evidence set — depends on your auditor, typically 6–10 weeks once controls are exercised.

Next steps I propose: 1) quick sync to agree which model to price to your CFO, 2) I’ll share a two‑page amortization view we can drop straight into your finance template, 3) legal (cc’ed) will review suggested contract language for amortization/crediting.

Attaching: cost_breakdown_greenline_v1.xlsx

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: cost_breakdown_greenline_v1.xlsx

From: Tom Myers <tom.myers@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 08:42:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Keystore options / evidence timing

Diego —

Thanks for the clear options. Two quick clarifying points from procurement and finance:
- Would Redwood be willing to amortize the implementation fee over 12 months and show it as a credit against usage for the first year? Our CFO is pushing to keep capital outlays low.
- If we sign a 12‑month commit, can you provide fixed tiers (band pricing) rather than usage‑only so we can forecast?

If those two items are doable, I think this goes straight to the greenlight meeting next week.

Tom
Tom Myers
Director, Procurement
Greenline Health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Greenline — amortization + banded commit ask (quick decision required)

Team —

Recap: Greenline (large regional provider) has asked two firm concessions: 12‑month amortization of the implementation fee as a usage credit for Year 1, and fixed banded pricing on a 12‑month commit so their CFO can forecast. They want a one‑pager to present at their greenlight meeting next Tues.

My read: both are standard and achievable with guardrails. My proposed counter (to present):
- Offer: amortize up to $75k of implementation fees as a monthly credit over 12 months, applied to usage invoices (pilot credit applied first).
- Commit bands: define 3 bands (Bronze: $25–74k/mo, Silver: $75–249k/mo, Gold: >= $250k/mo) with step discounts in the workbook. Lock bands for 12 months.
- Evidence delivery: commit to Milestone 1 & 2 timelines; SOC2 evidence depends on auditor cadence but we provide a documented package within 10 weeks post‑controls exercise.

Numbers: rough back‑of‑envelope based on their template (see attached). If they accept the $75k amortization + Silver band pricing we should close at ~ $1.1M ARR equivalent year 1. If they push Gold thresholds we scale nicely but risk heavier discounting.

Ask: Jonas / Vanessa — can you validate the margin impact of the $75k amortization and confirm band thresholds are operationally safe? Irene — can you skim and confirm there’s no legal blocker for amortization-as-credit language and advise any required clause (suggest: implementation fee credited over invoices, non‑refundable after 12 months)?

I attached a short draft one‑pager to present and the evidence delivery outline. I’ll be on the call with their procurement lead Monday morning. Please flag any redlines by EOD Monday.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: proposal_draft.docx, evidence_delivery_plan.pdf
